messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm starting a mini smokeboard for v3.1-int4-lite quant bring-up. Goal: verify onboarding metrics before we consider staging promote. Proposing a composite 'fidelity' metric (simple weighted combo of MRR and inverse-hallucination) computed vs last week's prod slice.

sahil: Love the idea. What's the minimum acceptable delta vs baseline? Numbers please so ops can wire alerts.

maya: Draft thresholds: auto-fallback if fidelity delta <= -1.0% sustained over 10m OR absolute MRR drop >= 2.0% in 5m. Immediate rollback if hallucination rate jumps by >0.5 percentage points. These are intentionally conservative for initial smoke.

liam: Can we make this seqlen-aware? Longform MRR is noisy. For requests >1024 tokens, soften the fidelity threshold by factor 1.5 (so -1.5% allowed) and require a larger sample to trigger.

eva: +1. Also add a structured-output fidelity signal — JSON parse / schema failures. If parse-fail rate increases >0.2pp, hold the rollout.

chao: Sample-size note: need N >= 5,000 treatment queries across the canary during a 30m window to trust early stopping. Suggest sequential hypothesis testing with alpha=0.01 for early rollback decisions.

maya: Ok, implemented a deploy policy draft — pasted below for feedback:

```yaml
canary:
  initial_traffic: 1%
  ramp_minutes: [10, 30, 60]   # durations to hold at each step
  check_window: 5m
  metrics:
    - name: fidelity
      delta_threshold: -0.01   # relative
      smoothing: ema(5m)
    - name: mrr
      absolute_drop: -0.02    # absolute drop threshold
    - name: halluc_rate
      absolute_increase: 0.005
    - name: structured_parse_fail
      absolute_increase: 0.002
    - name: kv_warmup_success
      min_success_rate: 0.95
  auto_fallback:
    criteria: "(critical_metric_once OR fidelity_two_consecutive_windows)"
    action: immediate-rollback
```

nora: Small nit: "critical_metric_once" is vague. I'd define critical metrics = {mrr, halluc_rate, kv_warmup_success}. If any critical metric breaches in a single check_window -> rollback. Fidelity (composite) requires two consecutive windows to avoid reacting to noise.

sahil: Also recommend a 24h quiet-burn shadow compare for long-docs before final promote. Shadowing will give us the long-tail signal without user impact.

maya: Good call. Plan: canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% progressive ramp with the above checks; concurrently route 10% of long-doc traffic to shadow for 24h. I'll add that to the runbook.

deploy-bot: Canary started for model v3.1-int4-lite; run id: r-2026032301; initial 1% traffic.

liam: One more ask — add KV warmup success rate metric to the dashboard (first 500 requests window). If success <95% mark degraded and trigger rollback.

maya: Done, added kv_warmup_success to the metrics block and dashboard. Scheduling the smokeboard run tomorrow 09:30 PT.

eva: LGTM, please raise a PR linking the policy to the playbook and add runbook escalation steps (:thumbsup:).

chao: I'll prepare the sequential test harness and hook it to our canary monitor. Will post test configs shortly.

maya: Thanks everyone — aiming for low-friction bring-up and conservative auto-fallback so we don't ship regressions. Will share post-smokeboard summary with A/B slices and the fidelity breakdown.
